ideas.pitch: An AI-powered logistics app connecting isolated seniors in rural Newfoundland communities with volunteer drivers for local errands and social outings.
ideas.title: AvalonOutreach
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the grand prize-winning Outreach project by addressing a deeply felt regional isolation issue in Atlantic Canada that community judges will immediately recognize and value.

ideas.pitch: A multimodal AI lost-and-found portal built for St. John's local businesses and transit, enabling residents to snap a photo and instantly match missing items.
ideas.title: StJohnsLostAndFound
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the GDG Hackathon winning Lumina formula to solve a hyper-local logistical pain point for St. John's students and merchants with a working live demo.

ideas.pitch: A real-time disaster management and flood monitoring platform tailored to Newfoundland's coastal weather patterns, aggregating community reports and live sensor data.
ideas.title: NLFloodGuard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets severe weather infrastructure readiness, a high-priority civic issue in Atlantic Canada, following the proven success pattern of the Oarfin disaster management platform.

ideas.pitch: A voice-first macOS assistant designed specifically to protect elderly Newfoundlanders from aggressive phone and email scams using local LLM inference.
ideas.title: GrandBanksGrandchild
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies the winning GOSIM Agentic Hackathon architecture to a pressing demographic vulnerability, combining hard technical execution with high social impact.

ideas.pitch: A multilingual and regional-dialect-aware AI health awareness chatbot tailored for rural Newfoundland and Labrador outport communities to navigate seasonal health risks.
ideas.title: BayBluffHealth
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the Sagacity win by solving healthcare access friction in semi-isolated rural regions, delivering clear, demonstrable community utility.
